description.ja: 「元祖ドラえもん」がFigure-rise Mechanicsにラインアップ！
description.en: "Original Doraemon" is now available in Figure-rise Mechanics!

description.ja: • 黄色いボディを成形色で再現し、元祖ドラえもんの特徴的な耳も新規造形で再現。
description.en: • The yellow body is reproduced in molding color, and the original Doraemon's distinctive ears are also reproduced with new modeling.

description.ja: • 口を別パーツにすることでシールレスを実現。さらに作りやすくなった！
description.en: • Seal-less is achieved by making the mouth a separate part. It's even easier to make!

description.ja: • クリアパーツ外装付属で、内部メカが丸わかり！
description.en: • Comes with clear parts for the exterior, allowing you to fully understand the internal mechanism!

description.ja: • 「タケコプター」が付属！別売りの「Figure-rise Mechanicsドラえもん」にもつけられるタケコプター取り付け用パーツも付属。
description.en: • "Takecopter " is included! Also included are Takecopter mounting parts that can be attached to the separately sold " Figure-rise Mechanics Doraemon".
